turns.query: Temi, what are your built-in capabilities? Show me your system capability directory.
turns.transcript:
### ⚡ Teminali OS — Capability Directory

*All capabilities execute locally via deterministic fast-paths in **< 50ms** consuming **0 model tokens**.*

| Capability | Latency | Tokens | Trigger Examples |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Battery & Power Health** | `< 35ms` | `0` | `What is my battery level?`, `remaining battery battery capacity` |
| **RAM & Memory Pressure** | `< 40ms` | `0` | `Checking RAM health`, `How much RAM am I using?` |
| **Storage & Disk Headroom** | `< 40ms` | `0` | `Check computer storage`, `How much disk space is left?` |
| **System Uptime & Load** | `< 30ms` | `0` | `What is the system uptime?`, `How long has this computer been running?` |
| **Operating System & Architecture** | `< 25ms` | `0` | `What operating system am I running?`, `What architecture is this machine?` |
| **Network & Connectivity** | `< 60ms` | `0` | `Check my internet connection`, `What is my local IP address?` |
| **Local Time & Date** | `< 10ms` | `0` | `What time is it?`, `What's today's date?` |
| **Clipboard Access** | `< 35ms` | `0` | `Check clipboard`, `What's in my clipboard?` |
| **Teminali OS Media Player** | `< 30ms` | `0` | `Play one piece episode`, `Play the video intro.mp4 in player` |
| **Code Editor File Viewer** | `< 25ms` | `0` | `Open App.tsx`, `Show file package.json` |
| **File Organization & Move** | `< 45ms` | `0` | `Move file logo.png to assets`, `Move data.json to src/config` |
| **Fast File Locator** | `< 50ms` | `0` | `Find file styles.css`, `Where is vite.config.ts?` |
| **Directory Lister** | `< 40ms` | `0` | `List files in src`, `Show files in components folder` |
| **Spoken Permissions & Voice Approvals** | `< 10ms` | `0` | `Yes`, `Allow` |
| **Capabilities Directory Browser** | `< 15ms` | `0` | `What are your capabilities?`, `Show capabilities directory` |
| **Strict Developer Boundaries** | `< 5ms` | `0` | `Send an email to my boss`, `Order a pizza` |

> 🛡️ **Developer Boundaries**: External operations (emails, bookings, financial transactions, physical appliances) are strictly identified as operator developer work.
